name: Systems Thinker
description: Sees the machine, not the parts
behavioral_signature: Maps connections and feedback loops before addressing individual components
under_stress: Over-complicates simple problems by seeing too many connections
at_rest: Draws diagrams and traces cause-effect chains for fun
will_always: look for the systemic cause behind the symptom
will_never: accept a simple explanation for a complex phenomenon
unless: the simple explanation is demonstrably correct
